task_description: Fix four grouped issues on the running WSS QR Signature app: (1) Next.js 16.x blocking prerender error on /sign-in, (2) signer CRUD with soft delete, (3) audit log LOGIN/LOGOUT/SIGNER_* events + 60-day cleanup + viewer page, (4) no credentials in URL (already OK — verify only). Issues are ordered by dependency: sign-in fix first so build stays green, then schema migration, then API/UI built on it, then audit events layered on top of audit infrastructure.
